content: Done. Two-pass dedup: plain pass finds boilerplate, second pass exempts sparse (<8 content words) slides. PDF: pdftoppm -singlefile per visual page. PPTX: embedded raster pictures via slide rels (no soffice); picture-less sparse PPTX slides are unflagged. Image artifacts copied to _images/ with pointer input. Cap 30/workspace (counted from _images/), session inputs before sources; sources get markers only. _session.md gets an Images section. Verified on real CPSC5005 decks: 43 images across 7 decks, BST deletion-case and recursion-tree diagrams captured.
